Full summary: Applied 30 claim-check findings to the final report (two Opus skeptics): corrected go/no-go statuses to distinguish library, operator and model level; moved runnable-but-unrun items from unavailable to not-tested; strengthened the simpler-baseline case; recommendation now asks the field question before the correction batches. Matrix gained three operator-surface rows. Real-host Claude Code test launched once at 2.1.291. Uncommitted: report, matrix, log, recovery doc (verifier still running).
Decisions: Chose to recommend asking the field whether concurrent conflicting writers are a present problem before investing in correction batches A–C, over scheduling the batches first — the skeptic showed the earlier order committed material v3 work before the question that could make it moot; Dave's trial-after-fixes ruling is unaffected
Findings: The session's commit fd9c241c included the auto-archiver's pruning of ~500 blackboard posts, among them the only record of the lane 03 Claude Code real-host run (post 01M2KK1826…); it survives only in git history at 0f9fd985
